name: Lightpanda
description: Installs the Lightpanda headless browser (CDP server, fetch, MCP) with telemetry disabled by default.

version.description: Lightpanda release tag to install ('latest', 'nightly' or a version like '1.0.1').

telemetry.description: Allow Lightpanda usage telemetry. When false, LIGHTPANDA_DISABLE_TELEMETRY is set for every invocation.

userAgent.description: User-Agent passed via --user-agent to serve/fetch/mcp/agent/run. Empty keeps the Lightpanda default. Must not contain 'Mozilla'.
